label: DESCRIPTIVE -- not a test, no verdict on any experiment
note: Annualised return per name over the window on the heuristic basis every registered experiment reads (backtest.back_adjust with its defaults, as backtesting/pit.py calls it) and on the exchange's own lists (corporate_actions.exchange_adjust). gap = exchange minus back_adjust, in percentage points a year; positive means the heuristic understates the total return. It says how far a multi-year comparison with TEDPIX (a price-and-dividend index) moves with the basis; it says nothing about the verdicts of E26 or E30-E33, which compared strategies with controls on one basis.
coverage_rule: fetched lists; >= 250 bars; first TRADED bar within 10 days of start, last bar within 10 days of end; no close at or below 10 rials

headline_lists_complete.note: names whose every frozen-close move is an event the lists carry (fill_untraded finds nothing): the exchange basis needs no heuristic here

lists_complete_exact_factors.note: of those, names whose increases all have exact factors (no first-trade estimate, no unpriced share change)

all_names_filled.note: every covered name, exchange basis with fill_untraded=True (unexplained frozen-close moves taken out as back_adjust does)

all_names_lists_only.note: every covered name, lists only: names with events the lists miss carry them as returns, so the tails here are list gaps

dividend_contribution_pct_yr.note: what the exchange's dividends alone add per year (product of 1/factor, annualised): the most a price-only basis could miss; back_adjust already takes out those re-priced on untraded bars

not_adjusted_equals_last_traded_close.note: the close of the last session WITH volume before the ex session; the last bar itself matches by construction of last_cum/first_ex

codal_agreement.rule: exchange DPS within 1 rial or 1% of Codal's
codal_agreement.offset_note: Codal publication date minus the exchange's dEven

pre_a5c810a_back_adjust.note: DESCRIPTIVE, computed once on 2026-11-24 (not by --audit): the back_adjust in force before commit a5c810a (2026-11-11), loaded from `git show a5c810a^:backtest.py`, on the same names and windows. gap = exchange basis minus that heuristic, pp/yr. No verdict on any experiment follows from it.

codal_disagreements_explained.note: 14 of the 19 have a share change between the fiscal year-end and the AGM whose ratio equals codal_dps / exchange_dps (e.g. حبندر 2930 vs 733, x4.0 on 2026-04-25): Codal quotes DPS on the old share count, the exchange on the new. The rest: 2 within 1.5% (rounding), لسرما 1500 vs 150, داراب Codal 0, سهرمز (a list of reversed x4/x0.25 share changes).
